prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create ONE cohesive landscape 3:2 hero artwork for "The Punisher", a playful couples accountability app. The user wants the mature sculptural, cinematic, and symbolic ideas woven together into a single picture, not a triptych, moodboard, split screen, or collage.
Scene: one architectural installation on a broad dark travertine tabletop in a warmly lit, intimate interior with a shadowy midnight-blue background. An exquisitely carved ivory-marble adult angel on the left and an equally detailed oxblood-marble adult devil on the right lean gently toward each other across a shared central upright smartphone. Their natural adult proportions and subtle knowing expressions suggest a couple reaching an agreement. They are museum-quality sculptures, not flesh-colored fantasy cartoons: realistic carved facial planes, small natural eyes, intricate swept hair, draped tailored clothing, fine stone veins and tactile surfaces. Angel has individually sculpted feather wings and a delicate aged-brass halo. Devil has restrained small curved horns and an elegant tail curving around the right edge of the composition. No weapons, no combat.
Unify everything physically: one curved marble bench supports both figures behind the central phone; the angel's wing sweeps inward behind the phone while the devil's tail curves inward along the base, together framing the shared agreement. Thin inlaid brass paths emerge from beneath the phone and branch across the SAME continuous stone surface into two small foreground outcome objects. Left: one richly detailed brushed-gold wrapped gift. Right: a refined ivory porcelain dish stack with a small sponge. No separated panels or separate diorama islands. Figures, phone, paths and outcomes all feel intentionally composed as one sculpture.
Phone interface: restrained warm ivory screen with crisp exact text "The Punisher" at top, "OUR AGREEMENT" below, one central task card "Plan our date", then two small options labelled "Reward" and "Consequence" with a gift and dish icon. Avoid a large completed checkmark over the task: the scene is about jointly agreeing on a task and its outcomes. One small heart between their inward-facing hands suggests mutual choice. A discreet front-edge inscription reads "The Punisher"; no other text outside the installation.
Art direction: sophisticated cinematic photograph of a real sculptural installation, not digital cartoon art. Directional warm lamp light from upper left, restrained cool rim from right, deep but readable contact shadows, soft bounce light, rich contrast. Aged brass, white marble, oxblood stone, finely veined travertine, satin glass. Clear hierarchy: the two adult sculptures and central shared task first, gift and dishes second. Natural human anatomy, carefully sculpted hands, understated faces. Elevated three-quarter camera, full installation visible with comfortable framing, no cropped wings, halo or base. Composition fills the wide frame without empty space. No oversized heads or eyes, no Pixar/Disney styling, no plastic toys, no superhero skull logo, no flames, no neon paths, no ornate wedding decor. Keep it mature, tactile, intimate, and visually unified.
